candidate.name: HIVE Digital Technologies FY2026 Bitcoin mining production versus treasury inventory

criteria.first_party_machine_readable: PASS: accession-specific SEC HTML exhibit; XBRL instance exists but metric-level extraction unverified
criteria.economic_entity_scope: PASS: HIVE company; mined production is distinct from custody stock
criteria.effective_clock: PASS: fiscal year ending 2026-03-31 for 2885 mined; 2026-03-31 for 150 stock
criteria.available_clock: PASS: SEC acceptance 2026-06-02 06:23:19 ET; no backdating to 2026-03-31
criteria.observed_clock: research observation 2026-10-10 20:27 ICT; no collector ingestion
criteria.non_overlap: NOT_ESTABLISHED for proposed additive capital-flow signal; mined output does not evidence independent buying or exchange sale
criteria.context_only: REQUIRED for mined-production/treasury stock; no directional scoring

candidate.rejection: Do not turn 2,885 BTC mined during a fiscal year into BTC purchasing flow, miner selling, or change in custody stock. The same report shows only 150 BTC held at year end; the difference cannot be assigned to dated exchange selling without independent transaction-level evidence. A single historical annual mining total is not a new independently attributable directional source, and the 150 BTC custody snapshot is a separate context-only metric not qualified as a fresh continuous collector by this review.
